title: With `-flambda2-join-algorithm n-way`, Simplify deletes an arm of a match that is taken
summary: At `-O2` and `-O3` with `-flambda2-join-algorithm n-way` (or with `-flambda2-match-in-match`), the arm for `Y2` of the last match on `d` is deleted and `f false Y2 true 5` is 3035 instead of 3055. Other programs abort with `Invalid code: unreachable switch case` or end with a segmentation fault.
cause: `n_way_join_round` in `middle_end/flambda2/types/env/join_env.ml` recovers the relation "the number of `d` is the tag of `x`" for `x`, which has a value on one path only.

fix.text: Recovers such a relation only for a variable that has a value at every use of the join. Builds; `test.ml` then prints the expected result; testsuite unchanged.

reference: related: PR #6502 (merged), a neighbouring fix to the relations the n-way join recovers
